title: Showing the drawing hand of the teacher in an anatomy video lecture—Effect on the student's learning, motivation, and cognitive load
reason: RCT of video-lecture format run on Moodle. The only LMS-side measure (MCQ duration) is compared between groups and over time; no relation of it to success or a construct is reported. Reported correlations involve self-reported motivation and cognitive load only.

extraction.n_quote: The whole sample ( n = 343) was constituted by 310 (89%) right‐handers and 37 (11%) left‐handers' students.
extraction.lms_indicators: MCQ pre/post scores and MCQ duration extracted from Moodle (duration only compared by group/time)
extraction.outcome_or_construct: MCQ learning gain; motivation (MSLQ, self-report); cognitive load (self-report)
extraction.notes: Correlations reported are self-report to self-report or self-report to test-score change: 'a positive—yet weak—correlation between motivation and the cognitive load ( r = 0.18, p = 0.02' and 'a negative and weak correlation between student cognitive load and MCQ score changes ( r = −0.11, p = 0.04'. Post-test time was entered in the correlation analysis but no coefficient for it is reported.
